```{python}
#| label: fig-layout-vpnp
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Cross section of the vertical substrate PNP available in any CMOS technology: the $p^+$ diffusion in the n-well is the emitter, the n-well is the base, and the common $p$-substrate is the collector (contacted at the surface and tied to $V_\\mathrm{SS}$)."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

C = dict(sub='#f5e9d0', nwell='#aacdea', nplus='#4a7fb5', pplus='#d1862c')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.0))
SURF = 3.0

ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0), 12, SURF, fc=C['sub'], ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(6, 0.4, 'p-substrate = collector', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((3.2, 1.0), 5.6, 2.0, fc=C['nwell'], ec='k',
                       lw=0.8))
ax.text(6, 1.3, 'n-well = base', ha='center', fontsize=8)


def diff(x0, w, typ):
    fc = C['nplus'] if typ == 'n' else C['pplus']
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, SURF - 0.5), w, 0.5, fc=fc, ec='k', lw=0.6))
    ax.text(x0 + w / 2, SURF - 0.25, f'${typ}^+$', ha='center',
            va='center', fontsize=8, color='white')


diff(0.7, 1.2, 'p')    # substrate/collector contact
diff(3.6, 1.2, 'n')    # base contact
diff(5.4, 1.2, 'p')    # emitter
diff(7.2, 1.2, 'n')    # base contact
diff(10.1, 1.2, 'p')   # substrate/collector contact

for x, t in [(1.3, 'C ($V_\\mathrm{SS}$)'), (4.2, 'B'), (6.0, 'E'),
             (7.8, 'B'), (10.7, 'C ($V_\\mathrm{SS}$)')]:
    ax.annotate(t, xy=(x, SURF), xytext=(x, SURF + 0.9), fontsize=9,
                ha='center', arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=0.8))

ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 12.2)
ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 4.6)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
